title: DaVSAIT: Unpaired Image Translation Based on Vector Symbolic Architecture and Dual Attention Mechanism (code)
description: Official PyTorch implementation of DaVSAIT, an unpaired image translation model that integrates a dual attention mechanism (multi-spectral channel attention and self-attention) into VSA-based adversarial learning. Includes training/testing code, configuration files and scripts for GTA→Cityscapes, Google Maps↔Aerial Photo, Cityscapes→CBCL, edges→shoes and grayscale→color flower translation.
